en.text: Which is the flag of the European Union?
en.context: The EU flag is a circle of twelve golden stars on a blue ground. The twelve stands for completeness, not for the number of member states.

text: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?

en.text: Which country is a neighbour of Germany?
en.context: Denmark is Germany's only northern neighbour, bordering Schleswig-Holstein.

text: Wie wird der Beitritt der DDR zur Bundesrepublik Deutschland im Jahr 1990 allgemein genannt?

en.text: What is the accession of the GDR to the Federal Republic of Germany in 1990 generally called?
en.context: The accession of the GDR in 1990 is generally called German reunification, die deutsche Wiedervereinigung.

text: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?

en.text: Which country is a neighbour of Germany?
en.context: Luxembourg borders Germany in the west, next to Rhineland-Palatinate and Saarland.

text: Das Europäische Parlament wird regelmäßig gewählt, nämlich alle …

en.text: The European Parliament is elected regularly, namely every …
en.context: The European Parliament is elected every five years. Every EU citizen may vote, and may do so in their country of residence.

text: Was bedeutet der Begriff "europäische Integration"?
options: Damit sind amerikanische Einwanderinnen und Einwanderer in Europa gemeint.
Der Begriff meint den Einwanderungsstopp nach Europa.
Damit sind europäische Auswanderinnen und Auswanderer in den USA gemeint.
Der Begriff meint den Zusammenschluss europäischer Staaten zur EU.

en.text: What does the term "European integration" mean?
options: It refers to American immigrants in Europe.
The term means a halt to immigration into Europe.
It refers to European emigrants in the USA.
The term means the joining together of European states to form the EU.
en.context: European integration means European states joining together ever more closely, a process that led to today's EU.

text: Wer wird bei der Europawahl gewählt?
options: die Länder, die in die EU eintreten dürfen

en.text: Who is elected in the European election?
options: the countries allowed to join the EU
the members of the European Parliament
en.context: The European election chooses the members of the European Parliament. The Commission is not elected by voters directly.

text: Welches Land ist ein Nachbarland von Deutschland?

en.text: Which country is a neighbour of Germany?
en.context: Czechia borders Germany in the south-east, along Bavaria and Saxony.

text: Wo ist ein Sitz des Europäischen Parlaments?

en.text: Where is one seat of the European Parliament?
en.context: Strasbourg is a seat of the European Parliament, which holds its plenary sessions there.

text: Der damalige französische Staatspräsident François Mitterrand und der damalige deutsche Bundeskanzler Helmut Kohl gedenken in Verdun gemeinsam der Toten beider Weltkriege. Welches Ziel der Europäischen Union wird bei diesem Treffen deutlich?
options: Reisefreiheit in alle Länder der EU
Frieden und Sicherheit in den Ländern der EU
einheitliche Feiertage in den Ländern der EU

en.text: The then French President François Mitterrand and the then German Federal Chancellor Helmut Kohl commemorate together in Verdun the dead of both world wars. Which aim of the European Union is made clear at this meeting?
options: freedom to travel to all EU countries
peace and security in the countries of the EU
uniform public holidays in the countries of the EU
en.context: Mitterrand and Kohl commemorating the dead of both world wars together at Verdun stands for the EU's central aim: lasting peace and security among its members.

text: Wie viele Mitgliedstaaten hat die EU heute?

en.text: How many member states does the EU have today?
en.context: The EU has 27 member states, following the United Kingdom's departure in 2020.

text: 2007 wurde das 50-jährige Jubiläum der "Römischen Verträge" gefeiert. Was war der Inhalt der Verträge?

en.text: In 2007 the 50th anniversary of the "Treaties of Rome" was celebrated. What were the treaties about?
options: the founding of the European Economic Community (EEC)
fixing the Oder-Neisse line as the eastern border
en.context: The Treaties of Rome of 1957 founded the European Economic Community, the forerunner of today's EU.

text: An welchen Orten arbeitet das Europäische Parlament?

en.text: In which places does the European Parliament work?
en.context: The European Parliament works in Strasbourg, Luxembourg and Brussels: plenary sessions in Strasbourg, committees in Brussels, administration in Luxembourg.

text: Durch welche Verträge schloss sich die Bundesrepublik Deutschland mit anderen Staaten zur Europäischen Wirtschaftsgemeinschaft zusammen?

en.text: Through which treaties did the Federal Republic of Germany join with other states to form the European Economic Community?
en.context: The Federal Republic joined the European Economic Community through the Treaties of Rome in 1957, as one of the six founding members.

text: Seit wann bezahlt man in Deutschland mit dem Euro in bar?

en.text: Since when has cash been paid in euros in Germany?
en.context: Euro notes and coins have been in use in Germany since 1 January 2002. The euro had existed as book money since 1999.

text: Frau Seger bekommt ein Kind. Was muss sie tun, um Elterngeld zu erhalten?
options: Sie muss an ihre Krankenkasse schreiben.
Sie muss einen Antrag bei der Elterngeldstelle stellen.
Sie muss nichts tun, denn sie bekommt automatisch Elterngeld.
Sie muss das Arbeitsamt um Erlaubnis bitten.

en.text: Ms Seger is having a baby. What does she have to do to receive parental allowance?
options: She has to write to her health insurance fund.
She has to submit an application to the parental allowance office.
She does not have to do anything, because she receives parental allowance automatically.
She has to ask the employment office for permission.
en.context: Parental allowance must be applied for at the Elterngeldstelle. It is not paid automatically.

text: Wer entscheidet, ob ein Kind in Deutschland in den Kindergarten geht?

en.text: Who decides whether a child in Germany goes to kindergarten?
en.context: Parents or legal guardians decide whether their child goes to kindergarten. There is an entitlement to a place from the age of one, but no obligation.

text: Maik und Sybille wollen mit Freunden an ihrem deutschen Wohnort eine Demonstration auf der Straße abhalten. Was müssen sie vorher tun?
options: Sie müssen nichts tun. Man darf in Deutschland jederzeit überall demonstrieren.
Sie können gar nichts tun, denn Demonstrationen sind in Deutschland grundsätzlich verboten.
Maik und Sybille müssen einen neuen Verein gründen, weil nur Vereine demonstrieren dürfen.

en.text: Maik and Sybille want to hold a demonstration in the street with friends where they live in Germany. What do they have to do beforehand?
options: They have to register the demonstration.
They do not have to do anything. In Germany you may demonstrate anywhere at any time.
They cannot do anything, because demonstrations are generally banned in Germany.
Maik and Sybille have to found a new association, because only associations may demonstrate.
en.context: A demonstration in public must be registered with the authorities beforehand, normally 48 hours in advance. Registration is a notification, not a request for permission.

text: Welchen Schulabschluss braucht man normalerweise, um an einer Universität in Deutschland ein Studium zu beginnen?

en.text: Which school-leaving qualification do you normally need to begin a degree at a university in Germany?
en.context: The Abitur is normally required to begin a degree at a university. There are other routes for people with vocational qualifications.

text: Wer darf in Deutschland nicht als Paar zusammenleben?

en.text: Who may not live together as a couple in Germany?
options: Hans (20 years old) and Marie (19 years old)
Tom (20 years old) and Klaus (45 years old)
Sofie (35 years old) and Lisa (40 years old)
Anne (13 years old) and Tim (25 years old)
en.context: A 13-year-old may not live with an adult as a partner; children are protected by law. The other pairs are all adults and free to choose.

text: Ab welchem Alter ist man in Deutschland volljährig?

en.text: At what age do you come of age in Germany?
en.context: You come of age in Germany at 18. From then on you can sign contracts, vote and decide for yourself where to live.

text: Eine Frau ist schwanger. Sie ist kurz vor und nach der Geburt ihres Kindes vom Gesetz besonders beschützt. Wie heißt dieser Schutz?

en.text: A woman is pregnant. She is specially protected by law shortly before and after the birth of her child. What is this protection called?
en.context: The protection is called Mutterschutz. It usually runs from six weeks before birth to eight weeks after, with a ban on dismissal.

text: Die Erziehung der Kinder ist in Deutschland vor allem Aufgabe …

en.text: In Germany, bringing up children is above all the task …
en.context: Article 6 of the Basic Law makes bringing up children the natural right and primary duty of parents. The state only supervises.

text: Wer ist in Deutschland hauptsächlich verantwortlich für die Kindererziehung?

en.text: Who is mainly responsible for bringing up children in Germany?
en.context: Parents are mainly responsible for bringing up their children. The state steps in only if the child's welfare is at risk.

text: In Deutschland hat man die besten Chancen auf einen gut bezahlten Arbeitsplatz, wenn man …

en.text: In Germany you have the best chance of a well-paid job if you …
options: are a member of a party.
en.context: Good qualifications give the best chance of a well-paid job. Religion, sex or party membership must not decide who is hired.

text: Wenn man in Deutschland ein Kind schlägt, …
options: geht das nur die Familie etwas an.
kann man dafür nicht bestraft werden.

en.text: If you hit a child in Germany, …
options: it is only the family's business.
you cannot be punished for it.
you can be punished for it.
en.context: Children have a legal right to a non-violent upbringing, so hitting a child is punishable in Germany.

text: In Deutschland …
options: darf man zur gleichen Zeit nur mit einer Partnerin/einem Partner verheiratet sein.
kann man mehrere Ehepartnerinnen/Ehepartner gleichzeitig haben.
darf man nicht wieder heiraten, wenn man einmal verheiratet war.
darf eine Frau nicht wieder heiraten, wenn ihr Mann gestorben ist.

en.text: In Germany …
options: you may be married to only one partner at a time.
you can have several spouses at the same time.
you may not marry again if you have been married once.
a woman may not marry again if her husband has died.
en.context: Only one marriage at a time is allowed. Remarriage after divorce or the death of a spouse is entirely possible.

text: Wo müssen Sie sich anmelden, wenn Sie in Deutschland umziehen?

en.text: Where do you have to register if you move house in Germany?
en.context: When you move house you must register at the Einwohnermeldeamt, normally within two weeks.

text: In Deutschland dürfen Ehepaare sich scheiden lassen. Meistens müssen sie dazu das "Trennungsjahr" einhalten. Was bedeutet das?
options: Die Ehegatten sind ein Jahr verheiratet, dann ist die Scheidung möglich.
Das Besuchsrecht für die Kinder gilt ein Jahr.
Die Ehegatten führen mindestens ein Jahr getrennt ihr eigenes Leben. Danach ist die Scheidung möglich.

en.text: In Germany, married couples may divorce. Usually they have to observe the "year of separation". What does that mean?
options: The divorce proceedings last a year.
The spouses are married for a year, then divorce is possible.
The right of access to the children applies for a year.
The spouses live their own separate lives for at least a year. After that, divorce is possible.
en.context: The year of separation means the spouses live separate lives for at least a year before the divorce can go through. It is meant to make sure the decision is final.

text: Bei Erziehungsproblemen können Eltern in Deutschland Hilfe erhalten vom …

en.text: For problems bringing up children, parents in Germany can get help from the …
en.context: The Jugendamt, the youth welfare office, advises and supports parents with problems bringing up their children.

text: Ein Ehepaar möchte in Deutschland ein Restaurant eröffnen. Was braucht es dazu unbedingt?
options: eine Gaststättenerlaubnis von der zuständigen Behörde

en.text: A married couple want to open a restaurant in Germany. What do they absolutely need for this?
options: approval from the residents' registration office
a restaurant licence from the competent authority
en.context: Running a restaurant requires a Gaststättenerlaubnis from the competent authority, especially where alcohol is served.

text: Eine erwachsene Frau möchte in Deutschland das Abitur nachholen. Das kann sie an …

en.text: An adult woman wants to catch up on her Abitur in Germany. She can do this at …
en.context: An Abendgymnasium, an evening grammar school, lets adults work towards the Abitur alongside a job.

text: Was darf das Jugendamt in Deutschland?
options: Es entscheidet, welche Schule das Kind besucht.
Es kann ein Kind, das geschlagen wird oder hungern muss, aus der Familie nehmen.
Es bezahlt das Kindergeld an die Eltern.
Es kontrolliert, ob das Kind einen Kindergarten besucht.

en.text: What is the youth welfare office in Germany allowed to do?
options: It decides which school the child attends.
It can take a child who is being beaten or going hungry out of the family.
It pays the child benefit to the parents.
It checks whether the child attends a kindergarten.
en.context: The youth welfare office may take a child out of the family if the child is being beaten or neglected. It is a last resort and a court is involved.

text: Das Berufsinformationszentrum BIZ bei der Bundesagentur für Arbeit in Deutschland hilft bei der …

en.text: The careers information centre (BIZ) at the Federal Employment Agency in Germany helps with …
en.context: The Berufsinformationszentrum helps with career choices and finding an apprenticeship. It is part of the Federal Employment Agency.

text: In Deutschland hat ein Kind in der Schule …

en.text: In Germany, a child at school has …
options: a right to unlimited free time.
en.context: School attendance is compulsory, so a child has a duty to attend. Education in state schools is free of charge.

text: Ein Mann möchte mit 30 Jahren in Deutschland sein Abitur nachholen. Wo kann er das tun? An …

en.text: A man wants to catch up on his Abitur in Germany at the age of 30. Where can he do this? At …
en.context: An evening grammar school is the usual route for adults who want to take the Abitur later in life.

text: Was bedeutet in Deutschland der Grundsatz der Gleichbehandlung?
options: Niemand darf z.B. wegen einer Behinderung benachteiligt werden.
Man darf andere Personen benachteiligen, wenn ausreichende persönliche Gründe hierfür vorliegen.
Niemand darf gegen Personen klagen, wenn sie benachteiligt wurden.
Es ist für alle Gesetz, benachteiligten Gruppen jährlich Geld zu spenden.

en.text: What does the principle of equal treatment mean in Germany?
options: No one may be disadvantaged because of a disability, for example.
You may disadvantage other people if there are sufficient personal reasons for it.
No one may sue people if they have been disadvantaged.
It is the law for everyone to donate money to disadvantaged groups every year.
en.context: Equal treatment means nobody may be disadvantaged because of things like disability, origin, sex, religion or age. The General Equal Treatment Act sets this out.

text: In Deutschland sind Jugendliche ab 14 Jahren strafmündig. Das bedeutet: Jugendliche, die 14 Jahre und älter sind und gegen Strafgesetze verstoßen, …
options: teilen die Strafe mit ihren Eltern.

en.text: In Germany, young people are criminally responsible from the age of 14. This means: young people who are 14 or older and break criminal laws …
options: share the punishment with their parents.
en.context: From 14 young people are criminally responsible and can be punished, though under juvenile law, which stresses education over retribution.

text: Zu welchem Fest tragen Menschen in Deutschland bunte Kostüme und Masken?

en.text: At which festival do people in Germany wear colourful costumes and masks?
en.context: At carnival, and especially on Rose Monday, people wear colourful costumes and masks. The celebrations are biggest in the Rhineland.

text: Wohin muss man in Deutschland zuerst gehen, wenn man heiraten möchte?

en.text: Where do you have to go first in Germany if you want to get married?
en.context: To marry you go first to the Standesamt, the registry office. Only a civil marriage is legally valid in Germany.

text: Wann beginnt die gesetzliche Nachtruhe in Deutschland?

en.text: When do the statutory quiet hours at night begin in Germany?
options: when the neighbours go to bed
en.context: Statutory quiet hours run from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Noise that disturbs the neighbours is not allowed during that time.

text: Eine junge Frau in Deutschland, 22 Jahre alt, lebt mit ihrem Freund zusammen. Die Eltern der Frau finden das nicht gut, weil ihnen der Freund nicht gefällt. Was können die Eltern tun?
options: Sie müssen die Entscheidung der volljährigen Tochter respektieren.
Sie haben das Recht, die Tochter in die elterliche Wohnung zurückzuholen.
Sie können zur Polizei gehen und die Tochter anzeigen.
Sie suchen einen anderen Mann für die Tochter.

en.text: A young woman in Germany, 22 years old, lives with her boyfriend. The woman's parents do not like this, because they do not approve of the boyfriend. What can the parents do?
options: They have to respect the decision of their adult daughter.
They have the right to bring the daughter back to the parental home.
They can go to the police and report the daughter.
They look for another man for the daughter.
en.context: At 22 the daughter is an adult and decides for herself whom she lives with. Her parents have to respect that.

text: Eine junge Frau will den Führerschein machen. Sie hat Angst vor der Prüfung, weil ihre Muttersprache nicht Deutsch ist. Was ist richtig?
options: Sie muss mindestens zehn Jahre in Deutschland leben, bevor sie den Führerschein machen kann.
Wenn sie kein Deutsch kann, darf sie keinen Führerschein haben.
Sie muss den Führerschein in dem Land machen, in dem man ihre Sprache spricht.
Sie kann die Theorie-Prüfung vielleicht in ihrer Muttersprache machen. Es gibt mehr als zehn Sprachen zur Auswahl.

en.text: A young woman wants to take her driving test. She is afraid of the test because her mother tongue is not German. What is correct?
options: She has to live in Germany for at least ten years before she can take the driving test.
If she does not speak German, she may not have a driving licence.
She has to take the driving test in a country where her language is spoken.
She may be able to take the theory test in her mother tongue. There are more than ten languages to choose from.
en.context: The theory test can be taken in a number of languages besides German, so limited German need not be an obstacle.

text: In Deutschland haben Kinder ab dem Alter von drei Jahren bis zur Ersteinschulung einen Anspruch auf …

en.text: In Germany, children from the age of three until they first start school are entitled to …
options: a place in a sports club.
en.context: From the age of three until they start school, children are entitled to a kindergarten place. Since 2013 the entitlement starts at one.

text: Die Volkshochschule in Deutschland ist eine Einrichtung …

en.text: The Volkshochschule (adult education centre) in Germany is an institution …
en.context: The Volkshochschule is an adult education centre, offering affordable courses in languages, computing and much else to anyone.

text: Was ist in Deutschland ein Brauch zu Weihnachten?
options: sich mit Masken und Kostümen verkleiden

en.text: What is a Christmas custom in Germany?
options: dressing up with masks and costumes
en.context: Decorating a fir tree is the classic German Christmas custom. The tradition spread from Germany around the world.

text: Welche Lebensform ist in Deutschland nicht erlaubt?
options: Mann und Frau sind geschieden und leben mit neuen Partnern zusammen.
Ein alleinerziehender Vater lebt mit seinen zwei Kindern zusammen.
Ein Mann ist mit zwei Frauen zur selben Zeit verheiratet.

en.text: Which way of life is not permitted in Germany?
options: A man and a woman are divorced and live with new partners.
A single father lives with his two children.
A man is married to two women at the same time.
en.context: Being married to two people at once is not allowed in Germany. Divorce, same-sex partnership and single parenthood are all perfectly lawful.

text: Bei Erziehungsproblemen gehen Sie in Deutschland …

en.text: For problems bringing up children in Germany, you go …
en.context: With problems bringing up children you go to the Jugendamt, which advises parents free of charge.

text: Sie haben in Deutschland absichtlich einen Brief geöffnet, der an eine andere Person adressiert ist. Was haben Sie nicht beachtet?

en.text: In Germany you have deliberately opened a letter addressed to another person. What have you disregarded?
en.context: Opening someone else's post deliberately breaches the privacy of correspondence, protected by Article 10 of the Basic Law.

text: Was braucht man in Deutschland für eine Ehescheidung?

en.text: What do you need for a divorce in Germany?
en.context: A divorce goes through the family court, and you need a lawyer to file the petition. Neither the parents nor the children have to consent.

text: Was sollten Sie tun, wenn Sie von Ihrer Ansprechpartnerin/Ihrem Ansprechpartner in einer deutschen Behörde schlecht behandelt werden?
options: Ich muss mir diese Behandlung gefallen lassen.
Ich kann mich bei der Behördenleiterin/beim Behördenleiter beschweren.

en.text: What should you do if you are treated badly by your contact person at a German public authority?
options: I have to put up with this treatment.
I can complain to the head of the authority.
en.context: If an official treats you badly you can complain to the head of the authority. Public authorities are answerable for how they treat people.

text: Eine Frau, die ein zweijähriges Kind hat, bewirbt sich in Deutschland um eine Stelle. Was ist ein Beispiel für Diskriminierung? Sie bekommt die Stelle nur deshalb nicht, weil sie …
options: keine Erfahrungen in diesem Beruf hat.

en.text: A woman who has a two-year-old child applies for a job in Germany. What is an example of discrimination? She does not get the job solely because she …
options: has salary expectations that are too high.
has no experience in this occupation.
en.context: Turning a woman down solely because she is a mother is discrimination. Language skills or lack of experience would be job-related reasons.

text: Ein Mann im Rollstuhl hat sich auf eine Stelle als Buchhalter beworben. Was ist ein Beispiel für Diskriminierung? Er bekommt die Stelle nur deshalb nicht, weil er …

en.text: A man in a wheelchair has applied for a job as an accountant. What is an example of discrimination? He does not get the job solely because he …
options: has salary expectations that are too high.
en.context: Refusing someone a desk job solely because he uses a wheelchair is discrimination on grounds of disability, which the General Equal Treatment Act forbids.

text: In den meisten Mietshäusern in Deutschland gibt es eine "Hausordnung". Was steht in einer solchen "Hausordnung"? Sie nennt …
options: Regeln für die Benutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel.
alle Mieterinnen und Mieter im Haus.
Regeln, an die sich alle Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner halten müssen.

en.text: Most blocks of rented flats in Germany have house rules. What do such house rules contain? They state …
options: all the tenants in the building.
rules that all residents have to observe.
the address of the nearest public order office.
en.context: House rules set out what all residents of the building have to observe — quiet hours, use of shared rooms, cleaning duties and so on.

text: Wenn Sie sich in Deutschland gegen einen falschen Steuerbescheid wehren wollen, müssen Sie …
options: warten, bis ein anderer Bescheid kommt.

en.text: If you want to challenge an incorrect tax assessment in Germany, you have to …
en.context: Against an incorrect tax assessment you lodge an objection, an Einspruch, normally within one month of receiving it.

text: Zwei Freunde wollen in ein öffentliches Schwimmbad in Deutschland. Beide haben eine dunkle Hautfarbe und werden deshalb nicht hineingelassen. Welches Recht wird in dieser Situation verletzt? Das Recht auf …

en.text: Two friends want to go to a public swimming pool in Germany. Both have dark skin and are therefore not let in. Which right is violated in this situation? The right to …
en.context: Refusing entry because of skin colour violates the right to equal treatment. Racial discrimination is forbidden by the Basic Law and by the Equal Treatment Act.

text: Welches Ehrenamt müssen deutsche Staatsbürgerinnen und Staatsbürger übernehmen, wenn sie dazu aufgefordert werden?

en.text: Which honorary office must German citizens take on if they are asked to do so?
en.context: German citizens can be required to serve as election helpers. It is one of the few honorary offices you cannot simply decline.

text: Was tun Sie, wenn Sie eine falsche Rechnung von einer deutschen Behörde bekommen?
options: Ich lege Widerspruch bei der Behörde ein.
Ich schicke die Rechnung an die Behörde zurück.
Ich gehe mit der Rechnung zum Finanzamt.

en.text: What do you do if you receive an incorrect bill from a German public authority?
options: I leave the bill lying around.
I lodge an objection with the authority.
I send the bill back to the authority.
I take the bill to the tax office.
en.context: If a bill from an authority is wrong you lodge a formal objection, a Widerspruch, with that authority.

text: Was man für die Arbeit können muss, ändert sich in Zukunft sehr schnell. Was kann man tun?
options: Es ist egal, was man lernt.
Erwachsene müssen auch nach der Ausbildung immer weiter lernen.
Kinder lernen in der Schule alles, was im Beruf wichtig ist. Nach der Schule muss man nicht weiter lernen.
Alle müssen früher aufhören zu arbeiten, weil sich alles ändert.

en.text: What you need to be able to do for work will change very quickly in future. What can you do?
options: It does not matter what you learn.
Adults have to go on learning even after their training.
Children learn everything at school that matters in a job. After school you do not have to go on learning.
Everyone has to stop working earlier because everything is changing.
en.context: Because the skills jobs need change quickly, adults have to go on learning after their training. This is called lebenslanges Lernen, lifelong learning.

text: Frau Frost arbeitet als fest angestellte Mitarbeiterin in einem Büro. Was muss sie nicht von ihrem Gehalt bezahlen?

en.text: Ms Frost works as a permanent employee in an office. What does she not have to pay out of her salary?
en.context: Value added tax is paid on purchases, not deducted from wages. Income tax and social insurance contributions are.

text: Welche Organisation in einer Firma hilft den Arbeitnehmerinnen und Arbeitnehmern bei Problemen mit der Arbeitgeberin/dem Arbeitgeber?

en.text: Which body in a company helps employees with problems with their employer?
en.context: The works council, the Betriebsrat, represents employees in dealings with the employer and is elected by the workforce.

text: Sie möchten bei einer Firma in Deutschland ihr Arbeitsverhältnis beenden. Was müssen Sie beachten?

en.text: You want to end your employment with a company in Germany. What do you have to observe?
en.context: When you resign you have to observe the notice period, the Kündigungsfrist, set out in your contract or by law.

text: Woraus begründet sich Deutschlands besondere Verantwortung für Israel?
options: aus der Mitgliedschaft in der Europäischen Union (EU)
aus den nationalsozialistischen Verbrechen gegen Juden
aus dem Grundgesetz der Bundesrepublik Deutschland

en.text: What is the basis of Germany's special responsibility for Israel?
options: the National Socialist crimes against Jews
the Basic Law of the Federal Republic of Germany
en.context: Germany's special responsibility for Israel arises from the National Socialist crimes against Jews, above all the murder of six million people in the Holocaust.

text: Ein Mann mit dunkler Hautfarbe bewirbt sich um eine Stelle als Kellner in einem Restaurant in Deutschland. Was ist ein Beispiel für Diskriminierung? Er bekommt die Stelle nur deshalb nicht, weil …
options: er keine Erfahrungen im Beruf hat.

en.text: A man with dark skin applies for a job as a waiter in a restaurant in Germany. What is an example of discrimination? He does not get the job solely because …
options: his German is not good enough.
his salary expectations are too high.
he has no experience in the job.
en.context: Refusing someone a job solely because of dark skin is racial discrimination and forbidden.

text: Sie haben in Deutschland einen Fernseher gekauft. Zu Hause packen Sie den Fernseher aus, doch er funktioniert nicht. Der Fernseher ist kaputt. Was können Sie machen?

en.text: You have bought a television in Germany. At home you unpack the television, but it does not work. The television is broken. What can you do?
options: make a complaint about the television
